Australia-ASO-problems.json.verification_notes: The Australian Science Olympiad Exam in Biology (the national IBO selection exam), one record per question with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the official question paper published by Australian Science Innovations and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers. © Australian Science Innovations.

Canada-NBC-problems.json.verification_notes: The National Biology Competition of the University of Toronto (Canada), one record per multiple-choice question with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the official exam paper published on the competition site and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers or answer keys. The questions remain the work of the University of Toronto National Biology Competition.

Cyprus-pancyprian-biology-problems.json.verification_notes: The Biology papers of the Cyprus Pancyprian examinations (university entrance), one record per question with all its sub-questions, tables and figures, Parts A–C: an English translation and the Greek original, both checked against the official paper published by the Examinations Service of the Cyprus Ministry of Education. Statements only: no answers. © the Cyprus Ministry of Education (Examinations Service).

Greece-panhellenic-biology-problems.json.verification_notes: The Biology papers of the Greek Panhellenic university-entrance exams (General Lyceum, regular June session), one record per ΘΕΜΑ (Part A–D) with all its sub-questions, tables and figures: an English translation and the Greek original, both checked against the official paper published by the Hellenic Ministry of Education. Statements only: no answers. © Hellenic Ministry of Education.

IBO-practical-problems.json.verification_notes: Practical exams, one record per printed part or task with its protocol, data, figures and every question, transcribed from the official English paper of the IBO examination papers archive and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers, answer keys or marking schemes. IBO examination papers © International Biology Olympiad, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

IBO-theory-problems.json.verification_notes: Theoretical papers only (practical exams are not included). One record per question, with every statement or option, table and figure, transcribed from the official English paper of the IBO examination papers archive and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers, answer keys or solutions. IBO examination papers © International Biology Olympiad, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

IJSO-biology-problems.json.verification_notes: The biology questions of the IJSO multiple-choice papers (the papers mix physics, chemistry and biology; only the questions whose content is biology are kept, with their printed numbers) the biology questions of the IJSO theory papers and the biology experiments of the IJSO experimental papers, one record per question or experiment with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the official English paper on ijsoweb.org and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers or solutions.

India-INBO-problems.json.verification_notes: The INBO theory paper (Sections A and B, numbered as printed), one record per question with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the official English question paper published by HBCSE-TIFR and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers or solutions. The questions remain the work of HBCSE and the INBO problem setters.

India-NSEB-problems.json.verification_notes: The NSEB (IAPT, with the Association of Teachers in Biological Sciences), the first stage of the Indian biology olympiad programme: one record per question with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the official question paper published by IAPT and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers or answer keys.

Japan-JBO-problems.json.verification_notes: English translations of the question statements of the Japan Biology Olympiad (JBO) 1st- and 2nd-round examinations, published with the written permission of the International Biology Olympiad Japan Committee (29 October 2026). Each problem is labelled as an English translation of the JBO original, © International Biology Olympiad Japan Committee (JBO), with links to the JBO past-papers page and the original PDF. Statements only: no answers or answer keys. Any problem is corrected or removed immediately at the JBO's request.

Latvia-biology-olympiad-problems.json.verification_notes: The tasks and tests of the 39th Latvian Biology Olympiad (2016/17): the regional round 2016 (novada olimpiāde, grades 9–12) and the state round 2017 (valsts olimpiāde: tasks for grades 9–10 and 11–12, tests for grades 9–12), from the collection “Mācību priekšmetu olimpiāžu uzdevumu un to risinājumu krājums – Bioloģija” (authors: Agnese Kokina, Jānis Liepiņš, Gunda Zvīgule-Neidere, Juris Ķibilds, Mārtiņš Vaivads, Zane Ozoliņa, Katrīna Daila Neiburga, Maruta Kusiņa, Aleksandra Boikova, Marta Rudzīte, Iluta Dauškane, Līga Ozoliņa-Molla, Jevgēņija Ņečajeva, Rūta Rozenfelde; scientific editor Valdis Pirsko; © Valsts izglītības satura centrs, 2021), published by the State Education Development Agency (VIAA). English translations of the Latvian original, shown next to it, published with the written permission of VIAA (20 November 2026); free and non-commercial; not affiliated with or endorsed by the organisers of the Latvian Biology Olympiad. Statements only: no answers, solutions or explanations. Question 21 of the grade-11 test was annulled by the organisers.

Mexico-UNAM-OUC-biology-problems.json.verification_notes: The Biology exams of the Olimpiada Universitaria del Conocimiento of the Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM), 2012–2019 and 2021–2025 (one exam a year, as published on www.olimpiadas.unam.mx), one record per printed question with all its options, in printed order: an English translation and the Spanish original. Reproduced without commercial purpose, without alteration (the Spanish original is kept beside the translation) and with the full source and web address, as the terms of the UNAM site allow (art. 148 of the Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor). Statements only: no answers.

NewZealand-NZIBO-problems.json.verification_notes: The NZIBO national entrance examination (and the 2011 selection examination), one record per question with every option, statement, table and figure, transcribed from the official paper published by NZIBO and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers. © NZIBO.

Spain-Andalucia-PAU-biology-problems.jso.verification_notes: The Biology papers of the Andalusian university-entrance exams (PAU / PEvAU, Prueba de acceso y admisión a la universidad; Andalucía, Ceuta, Melilla and centres in Morocco), 2008–2026, six papers a year (main, substitute and reserve papers of each session), one record per printed question in printed order (Option A/B, Block A/B/C or Exercise, as the first line says): an English translation and the Spanish original from the official papers published by the Junta de Andalucía (Distrito Único Andaluz). Información obtenida del Portal de la Junta de Andalucía: texts reused under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 licence of the Portal (source cited, meaning not altered; no endorsement implied). Figures credited in a paper to third parties are not reproduced. Statements only: no answers or marking criteria (the 2009 files also print the criteria, which are not used).

Spain-Catalonia-PAU-biology-problems.jso.verification_notes: The Biology papers of the Catalan university-entrance exams (PAU, Proves d'accés a la universitat), one record per printed exercise with all its questions, tables and figures: an English translation and the Catalan original from the official paper published by the Generalitat de Catalunya (Consell Interuniversitari de Catalunya), reused under the Catalan open information-use licence (Llicència oberta d'ús d'informació – Catalunya; source cited, content not altered). Figures credited in the paper to third parties are not reproduced: a bracketed description replaces them. Statements only: no answers or marking criteria.

Spain-Madrid-PAU-biology-problems.json.verification_notes: The Biology papers of the university-entrance exams of the public universities of the Comunidad de Madrid (EvAU, Evaluación para el acceso a las enseñanzas universitarias oficiales de grado), 2020–2024, ordinary and extraordinary sessions, one record per printed question (A.1–A.5, B.1–B.5) in printed order: an English translation and the Spanish original from the official papers published by the Comunidad de Madrid (www.comunidad.madrid, retrieved 24 Nov 2026). Reused under the reuse terms of the legal notice of comunidad.madrid (Ley 37/2007): content and meaning not altered (the Spanish original is kept beside the translation), source and date of retrieval cited, no sponsorship or endorsement by the Comunidad de Madrid implied. Statements only: the papers also print marking criteria and solutions (pages 3–5), which are not used

Switzerland-SBO-problems.json.verification_notes: English translations of the question statements of the Swiss Biology Olympiad 1st- and 2nd-round exams, published with the written permission of the Swiss Biology Olympiad (27 October 2026). Each question is labelled as an English translation of the original (German edition; the exams also exist in French and Italian), with a link to the archive and the original PDF. Statements only: no solutions. Exam questions © Swiss Biology Olympiad (Wissenschafts-Olympiade). Any question is corrected or removed immediately at the organisers' request.

Taiwan-AST-biology-problems.json.verification_notes: The Biology papers of Taiwan's university-entrance subject exams (Advanced Subjects Test: 分科測驗 from 2022, 指定科目考試 2002–2021), one record per printed question (questions of a group repeat the shared passage): an English translation and the Chinese original from the official question paper published by the College Entrance Examination Center (CEEC). Under Article 9(1)(5) of Taiwan's Copyright Act, questions of examinations held pursuant to law are not subject to copyright. Figures or texts credited in the paper to third parties are not reproduced: a bracketed description replaces them. Statements only: no answers or marking principles.

USA-Massachusetts-MCAS-biology-problems..verification_notes: The released items of the Massachusetts Comprehensive Assessment System (MCAS) high-school Biology test (spring, paper-based version), one record per printed item with every option, table and figure; the items of a section repeat its shared passage. Transcribed from the official release published by the Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education and checked against its page images. Copied under the permission printed in every release ("Permission is hereby granted to copy for non-commercial educational purposes any or all parts of this document"); credit: Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education. Statements only: the item-information tables of the release (correct answers) are not reproduced.

USA-NAEP-science-life-science-problems.j.verification_notes: The released Life Science questions of the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP) science assessments, grades 8 and 12 (2000–2024), one record per question with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the NAEP Questions Tool of the National Center for Education Statistics (U.S. Department of Education). NAEP material is in the public domain; photographs that NAEP credits to third parties are not reproduced: a bracketed description replaces them. Statements only: no answers, scoring guides or student responses.

USA-NSB-biology-problems.json.verification_notes: The Biology (High School) and Life Science (Middle School) questions of the official National Science Bowl sample question sets published by the U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science: one record per printed question number of a round, with its toss-up and bonus question as printed (multiple-choice options W–Z). Moderator pronunciation aids are omitted. Statements only: the answers printed in the source are not reproduced. Public domain (U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science); National Science Bowl® is a registered trademark of the U.S. Department of Energy.
